water.department_name: MCC Water Supply & Sewerage Operations (Public Health Wing)
water.office_location: MCC Head Office, New Deluxe Building, Sector 17, Chandigarh
policy_snippets: Disputed water bills received via e-Sampark may be submitted for re-metering within 30 days. Disputed billing complaints are resolved within 15 working days. No testing fee if meter is defective (+/- 3%).
Major pipeline leakages or contamination in sector lines must be inspected within 4 hours and repaired within 24 to 48 hours.
Sewerage blockages and overflowing manholes are cleared via super-suction machines within 24 hours of filing.
Official 24x7 Water Supply Control Room: 0172-2540200 | MCC ICCC: 0172-2787200.

electricity.office_location: Electricity Operation Circle, UT Secretariat, Sector 18, Chandigarh
policy_snippets: Power outages exceeding 4 hours in urban sectors must be logged on the outage portal and restored within 4 hours. Unresolved outages escalate to SDO after 2h and Executive Engineer after 4h.
Distribution transformer breakdowns or 11kV feeder faults must be replaced and supply restored within 24 to 72 hours under JERC standards.
Defective or burnt electricity meters are inspected within 7 working days and replaced within 15 working days.
24x7 Central Power Call Centre: 19121 | Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum (CGRF), Sector 18.

sanitation.department_name: MCC Medical Officer of Health (MOH) — Sanitation & Waste
sanitation.office_location: MOH Wing, Municipal Corporation, Sector 17, Chandigarh
policy_snippets: Missed door-to-door segregated garbage collection vehicle must be redressed within 24 hours of citizen reporting.
Accumulated garbage dumps, overflowing Sehaj Safai Kendras (SSKs), or dead animal removal must be cleared within 12 to 24 hours.
Waste processing complaints and storm-water drain choking must be addressed within 48 hours.
Dedicated MCC WhatsApp Grievance Hotline: 9915762917 | Central Control Room: 0172-2787200.

roads.office_location: B&R Division, Municipal Corporation, Sector 17, Chandigarh
policy_snippets: Non-functional LED streetlights on sector roads (V3/V4/V5/V6) or dark spots must be repaired within 3 to 7 working days under EESL contract.
Dangerous potholes, road cave-ins, or damaged footpaths on sector roads must be repaired with bitumen patchwork within 7 working days.
Overgrown tree branches obstructing streetlights or road signboards must be pruned within 5 working days.
An RTI application can be filed online or via any e-Sampark center in Chandigarh with the statutory ₹10 application fee.
The Public Information Officer (PIO) must furnish information within 30 days of application receipt.
If information concerns life or liberty of a person, it must be provided within 48 hours.
